description.narrative: The secondary road improvement project will rehabilitate a road which extends for about 50 kilometers from Dzirula to Chumateleti via Kharagauli in Central Georgia to two-lane all-weather standard, including several short access roads to the nearby national park and to Kharagauli and other railway stations. The project impact will be aligned with the increased economic activity in Kharagauli municipality and surrounding regions and national connectivity. The outcome will be increased mobility and accessibility of the residents of Kharagauli municipality and tourists visiting the project area by reducing vehicle operating costs and providing time savings for road users.

description.narrative: Improved efficiency and increased mobility and accessibility of the residents of the Kharagauli municipality and tourists visiting the project area

Traffic using the project road increased to 46,000 average daily vehicle-km (2014 baseline: 19,000 average daily vehicle-km) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Assessment of outcome shall be made at completion of project. Data Source: Roads Department of Georgia statistics and National Statistics Office of Georgia project performance management system and project completion report

Average journey time by road between Dzirula and Moliti (Marelisi Railway Station) reduced to at most 1 hours (2014 baseline: 2 hours) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Assessment of outcome shall be made at completion of project. Data Source: Roads Department of Georgia statistics and National Statistics Office of Georgia project performance management system and project completion report

Number of visitors to the Borjomi-Kharagauli National Park from the Kharagauli entrance increased by 7.5% (2014 baseline 2,500 visitors) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Assessment of outcome shall be made at completion of project. Data Source: Borjomi-Kharagauli National Park visitor statistics.
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Dzirula-Moliti (Marelisi Railway Station) section (part of Dzirula-Chumateleti road) improved and open to traffic Indicator: Entrepreneurship training for 100 persons of whom 50% are women provided by 2021 (2014 baseline: 0) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Completed. Data Source: Executing agency's project completion reports

Output: Dzirula-Moliti (Marelisi Railway Station) section (part of Dzirula-Chumateleti road) improved and open to traffic Indicator: 25-km road section between Dzirula and Moliti (Marelisi Railway Station) improved to two-lane all-weather standard with IRI of less than 6 m/km by 2021 (2014 baseline 15 m/km) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Civil works for Section 1 (Dzirula-Moliti Road) have been completed.
Civil works contract for Section 2 (Moliti-Chumateleti) have been removed from the scope. Data Source: Executing agency's project completion reports

Output: Dzirula-Moliti (Marelisi Railway Station) section (part of Dzirula-Chumateleti road) improved and open to traffic Indicator: Average annual usability of the road increased to 330 days by 2022 (2014 baseline: 270 days) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Will be assessed at completion.
